# The models of the MAGIA mesh: the host hart runs the graph, the mesh its
# FP16 matrix products (Buddy's magia dialect).
#
# DESIGN_CMAKE is the description of a MAGIA device config, generated by
# `bbdev stack --build "--config magia/devices/magia/configs/<Config>.toml
# --device magia"`, which also builds the firmware of the tiles and the
# runtime of the host that the programs of the device link.
#
# A recipe has a check, the compiled model on this machine with the mesh's
# products in software (<model>-model-check), and the program of the device
# (<model>-model-build).
include("${DESIGN_CMAKE}")
set(MAGIA_RUNTIME "${DESIGN_HART_STACK_magia}/runtime")
# The boot of the host hart: start.S, syscalls.c.
set(BOOT_DIR "${STACK_ROOT}/runtime/boot")
list(TRANSFORM DESIGN_DEFS PREPEND "-D" OUTPUT_VARIABLE DESIGN_DEFINES)
# The model region of the DDR, where a Linux runner maps its weights from.
math(EXPR MODEL_OFFSET "${DESIGN_DEVICE_DDR_BYTES} - ${DESIGN_DEVICE_DDR_MODEL}")
math(EXPR MODEL_IMAGE "${DESIGN_DEVICE_DDR_BASE} + ${MODEL_OFFSET}" OUTPUT_FORMAT HEXADECIMAL)
# What a compiled graph calls of MLIR's runtime, in the Linux runners (shared libraries).
add_library(magia-runtime OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL "${RUNTIME_DIR}/services/mlir.cpp")
target_include_directories(magia-runtime
  PRIVATE "${BUDDY_SOURCE}/llvm/mlir/include/mlir/ExecutionEngine"
)
set_target_properties(magia-runtime
  PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)

if(MODEL)
  add_subdirectory("${MODEL}")
else()
  add_subdirectory(bert-base-uncased-emotion)
  add_subdirectory(qwen3-0-6b)
endif()
